text: The teachers in the discipline have carried out in recent years a number of "863" projects, the National Natural Science Foundation projects and provincial, ministerial key projects, and it is one of the researchers in China in the third generation mobile communication standard, WDM, all-one transmission networks, and optical Internet Architecture. With its internationally prominent researches, over 150 papers have been selected by SCI, EI and ISTP Retrieval System; The research "TD-SCDMA mobile communications standard" has won the national second prize in scientific and technological progress, " research of communications - radio and television transmission network's practical technology" the first prize of Chongqing Municipal Science and Technology Award; It has developed the world's first 0.13-micron TD-SCDMA mobile phone baseband chip which has won the special honor of the 2005 College 10 major scientific and technological developments of the Ministry of Education. The discipline, granted the master-degree program in 1993, is a key discipline of the Ministry of Information Industry and Chongqing Municipality, and one of the first disciplines to set the post of Bayu academic scholars in Chongqing Municipality, and is, at the same time , one of the 14 key disciplines listed for privileged construction during the "10th Five-Year-Plan". It is equipped with key provincial and ministerial laboratories, a provincial-level engineering research center, and two university-level research centers as platforms; It has 17 professors (8 doctor tutors), 36 associate professors, 19 of whom have a doctoral degree. It cooperates in projects and offers a master program jointly with the National University of Singapore, Ultra-Wideband Information Network Research Center of University of Melbourne of Australia projects, and offers a doctoral program jointly with nearly 10 famous and key universities at home such as Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications, the University of Electronic Science and Technology, Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications.
